title: SitecoreAI CLI Root Configuration
description: Defines the Sitecore AI CLI root configuration

defaultEnvProfile.description: Default environment profile to fetch or push data to

envProfiles.description: Named environment profiles used by this CLI

modules.description: Sitecore module file resolution globs. Optional — only used by serialization-driven workflows (`scai provision ser …`, `scai provision recipe …`). Brief / Pages / publish-only configs can omit it.

recipes.description: Globs locating .recipe.ts / .recipe.json files for `scai provision recipe compile|plan|push`. Defaults to `recipes/**/*.recipe.ts` if unset.

brand.description: Brand credentials (Brand Management, Brand Review, Documents, Pipeline) keyed by Sitecore organizationId — the credential `scai brand` uses. Backed by AI APIs keys, which are one-org-per-credential and use scopes separate from the env automation client.

aiSkills.description: Deprecated: legacy name for `brand` (the block was called `aiSkills` before the rename). Accepted for back-compat with older configs; the CLI writes `brand`.

orgClients.description: Non-secret metadata of the scai-minted org-scoped automation clients, keyed by Sitecore organizationId. One per org, shared by every env profile in it. The matching secret lives in the OS keychain, never on disk.

defaultMaxRelativeItemPathLength.description:
Max relative item path length to serialize before considering path too long (and requiring aliasing to shorten).
Overridable on a per-module basis; this is the default when it is unspecified.

defaultModuleRelativeSerializationPath.description:
The default relative physical path from a module file where serialized items for that module will be stored.
For example given module /c/foo/bar.module.json, and default '/serialization/items' path,
the serialized items for bar would be stored at /c/foo/bar/serialization/items.
Prefix the path with ~/ for a root configuration relative path instead of a module-relative path.
Use '$(module)' to insert the module name when using a root relative path.
Overridable on a per-module basis; this is the default when it is unspecified.

removeOrphansForRoles.description: Specifies remove orphans functionality for roles serialization

removeOrphansForUsers.description: Specifies remove orphans functionality for users serialization

continueOnItemFailure.description: Specifies behavior when item synchronization fails

clientId.description: Client ID of the AI APIs key created in Cloud Portal → Stream → Admin → AI APIs keys. The matching secret lives in the OS keychain, never on disk.

audience.description: OAuth audience to request. Defaults to https://api.sitecorecloud.io.

tokenExpiresIn.description: Last-known expires_in (seconds) of the cached access token. Advisory only — actual cached token lives in the keychain.

tokenLastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last token mint. Advisory only.

AutomationClientMetadata.description: Non-secret metadata of a scai-minted automation client. The matching client secret lives in the OS keychain, never on disk.

clientId.description: OAuth client id of the scai-minted automation client.

name.description: Display name of the client in the Cloud Portal (the scai-* name).

mintedAt.description: ISO timestamp the client was minted.

telemetryEnabled.description: Determines if anonymous usage telemetry is sent. Enabled by default; opt out with 'scai cli telemetry disable', SITECOREAI_TELEMETRY=false, or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

cacheAuthenticationToken.description: Determines if the CLI should cache CM access/refresh tokens in the OS keychain.

versionComparisonEnabled.description: Determines if CLI\SMS version comparison is enabled.

apiClientTimeoutInMinutes.description: Determines timeout for Sitecore Api client.

EnvironmentConfiguration.description: Configures a named Sitecore environment profile

name.description: Optional display name for the environment

ref.description: Name of the environment to inherit from

allowWrite.description: Whether writing data to this endpoint is allowed (i.e. to prevent accidental writes to production)

denyMcpElevation.description: When true, MCP write tools refuse to operate against this environment regardless of the host's write-confirmation UX. Use for production-shaped envs where destructive ops must originate from a human CLI call (--allow-write) and never an MCP-elevated context. Defaults to false.

host.description: Base URL to the Sitecore instance to connect to (i.e. http://{my-sitecore-instance}.sitecorecloud.io)

authority.description: Base URL to SitecoreAI identity authority (e.g. https://auth.sitecorecloud.io)

useClientCredentials.description: Bring-your-own-client escape hatch: when true, scai uses the operator-supplied clientId + SITECOREAI_ENV_<ENV>_CLIENT_SECRET client-credentials grant instead of an interactive device login. Use this only when supplying your own automation client; otherwise let `scai setup client create` mint one.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token for this endpoint. Cached in the OS keychain when enabled.

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for this endpoint. Cached in the OS keychain when enabled.

refreshTokenParameters.description: OAuth refresh parameters for this endpoint (set manually if needed)

expiresIn.description: Preserves access token lifetime. Set during the login operation. Related to LastUpdated property. System use only.

lastUpdated.description: Preserve date and time when environment was updated. System use only.

deployToken.description: Deprecated: token-cache metadata. The deploy token is stored in the OS keychain; this field is read only for back-compat with older configs.

deployTokenExpiresIn.description: expires_in (seconds) of the cached deploy token. Freshness metadata recorded so the auto-wizard can decide whether a re-login is due. The token string itself lives in the OS keychain.

deployTokenLastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last deploy-token mint. Paired with deployTokenExpiresIn.

editingHostEnvironmentIds.description: Editing host environment IDs associated with this CM environment

clientId.description: Bring-your-own-client escape hatch: the OAuth client ID of an automation client you supply yourself instead of letting `scai setup client create` mint one. Pair with useClientCredentials. The matching secret is supplied via SITECOREAI_ENV_<ENV>_CLIENT_SECRET and is never stored in the config file.

automationClient.description: Non-secret metadata of the env-scoped automation client scai minted for this environment (`scai setup client create <env>`). The matching secret lives in the OS keychain, never on disk. Distinct from the bring-your-own-client clientId/useClientCredentials hatch.

variables.description: Defines variables that are specific to this environment. Variables defined here override any definitions in the root configuration for this environment.

audience.description: The unique identifier of the audience for an issued token

templatesRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates template items (e.g. /sitecore/templates/Project/<site>/Components). Tenant-specific. Used as fallback when --templates-root is not passed.

componentsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates component template items in the per-site folder layout (`<componentsRoot>/<section>/<Component>`). When unset, the compiler falls back to `templatesRoot` and emits the legacy flat layout. Used as fallback when --components-root is not passed.

contentModelsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates content-template items (`<contentModelsRoot>/<group>/<name>` when grouped, flat otherwise). When unset, content templates fall back to `templatesRoot` and land mixed in with components. Used as fallback when --content-models-root is not passed.

renderingsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates rendering items (e.g. /sitecore/layout/Renderings/Project/<site>). Tenant-specific. Used as fallback when --renderings-root is not passed.

partialDesignsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates partial-design items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Presentation/Partial Designs). Required for PartialDesignRecipe compilation.

pageDesignsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates page-design items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Presentation/Page Designs). Required for PageDesignRecipe compilation; also seeds crossRecipeRefs for the cross-recipe TemplatesMapping aggregate.

contentItemsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates shared content items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Data). Required for ContentItemRecipe compilation.

headlessVariantsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates SXA Headless rendering variants (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Headless Variants). Required when any recipe in the set declares variants.

availableRenderingsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates SXA Available Renderings section items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Available Renderings). One section per `recipe.section` is emitted with all renderings in that section listed in the Renderings field.

presentationStylesRoot.description: Sitecore parent path for the per-site SXA Headless Styles bucket (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Styles). Consumed by `scai provision recipe prune-defaults` to remove the OOTB style buckets SXA seeds here.

enumerationsRoot.description: Sitecore parent path under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates EnumerationRecipe items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<siteCollection>/<site>/Presentation/Enumerations). Each enum lands as `<enumerationsRoot>/<EnumName>` with one child item per declared value. Required for EnumerationRecipe compilation, and for any recipe whose fields carry `sitecore.enumHandle`.

placeholderSettingsRoots.description: Sitecore content-tree paths to walk when resolving recipe-declared `placeholders` to Placeholder Settings items (matched by their `Placeholder Key` field). Typically the per-site Presentation/Placeholder Settings AND the Layout/Placeholder Settings/Project/<site> path.

placeholderSettingsRoot.description: Sitecore content-tree root under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` CREATES recipe-defined Placeholder Settings items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<site>/Presentation/Placeholder Settings). Distinct from placeholderSettingsRoots (the plural walk list).

pageTemplatesRoot.description: Sitecore templates root under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates PageTemplateRecipe items (e.g. /sitecore/templates/Project/<site>). Optional; falls back to templatesRoot.

pagesRoot.description: Sitecore content-tree root under which `scai provision recipe compile|push` creates PageRecipe items (e.g. /sitecore/content/<tenant>/<site>/Home). Required for PageRecipe compilation.

recipeRoots.description: Preferred nested form of the *Root fields. Flattened into the matching flat fields at config-load time (recipeRoots wins when both are set; a warning fires).
